posts.text: A launch can win on one site and flop on another, same day, same product. SKI hit #1 on Product Hunt with 641 votes. Its Hacker News "Show HN" post got 15 points, because a non-maker account posted it instead of the founder. Hacker News rewards founder presence and story; Product Hunt rewards coordinated same-day mobilization. If you only get one shot, post it yourself.
